candidates.description: This feature vector represents abstract nouns and events relating to matters, topics, or occurrences.
These tokens represent French elided articles and prepositions attached to words via apostrophes.
This vector represents common French adverbial modifiers of degree, time, and logical relation.
This vector represents word endings, suffixes, and morphological roots containing the "ion" sequence across multiple languages.
The feature vector activates strongly on lowercase and uppercase French words or syllables containing the letter 'é'.
This vector activates in the context of traditional Hebrew and biblical male given names.
This vector represents Roman numerals used for numbering, sequencing, or names.
This feature vector represents abstract philosophical, intellectual, and theological concepts and terms.
This feature activates on tokens and subwords starting with the letter 'h'.
This vector activates strongly for words, name fragments, and morphemes containing the "ach" or "sh" phonetic sequences.
